title: Counter-evidence — Neon Koi (challenger claim)
report: The challenger 0x8b9A964d19c13Edf97c7dE797A9424F28f7C0F37 claims to be the creator of 'Neon Koi'. The counter-evidence shows only that the challenger posted an image resembling 'Neon Koi' on 2026-10-20, eighteen days after the registered creator's first publication. No creation date for the challenger is stated. No signed message from the challenger is provided. No earlier publication is shown. The counter-evidence does not prove the challenger created the work, and does not prove creation earlier than 2026-10-01.
